measurement.method: macOS UI automation launch from no running debug-bundle process, then poll the accessibility tree until the Local tab, connected state, terminal input entry area, and visible zsh prompt are all present

limitations: The timing includes the UI automation launch request and accessibility-tree polling; it is not an OS process-start stopwatch.
This covers local shell/workspace recovery only, not a real external SSH host's first interactive prompt.
Human physical keyboard, real macOS IME, Windows/Pageant, and serial hardware acceptance remain unverified.
